basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old automotive enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest with a penchant for video games and quirky animations. By day, I work as a mechanical engineer, designing parts for electric vehicles. By night, you'll find me tinkering with my car or diving into the world of Rocket League. When I'm not working or gaming, I enjoy exploring the outdoors with my partner and our two dogs. I'm nocturnal by nature, so you'll usually catch me online during late-night hours.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering from a state university, and I've spent the last five years working in the automotive industry. My interest in cars started young, fueled by countless hours spent in the garage with my dad. I've also developed a keen eye for detail through self-taught graphic design, which I apply to customizing cars and gaming setups.
